_doc: Publication policy for `wh publish` (ADR-0005). Fail-closed: anything not
listed here is NOT published, and its appearance FAILS the build rather than
defaulting to serve. Adding a zone or a note folder is a deliberate act.
Values: 'serve' = copied to zones/_serve/ and reachable by the remote read
Held note folders propagate: their atoms and both vector tables are removed
too, because t2_atom carries note text verbatim.
This is the EXAMPLE. Copy to serve-manifest.json and decide every line
yourself — an inherited publication policy is not a decision, and this file
is the only thing standing between your record and the internet.

zone_notes.t0_chat: Your own turns only. The assistant's half is another model's output, not your words.
zone_notes.t1_procedure: Your own methods, published as MCP resources (ADR-0016). Listing it here only lets a procedure BE published — each one still carries its own serve: flag, and a served one that reads a held zone fails the build.
zone_notes.rows: The cross-zone provenance union. Held: it is a join surface, not an answer.

note_folders._doc: The folder axis. Every folder your vault contains must appear here or the build fails — that is the point: a new folder is a decision, not a default.

path_zone_notes._axis: Gradient position, independent of note_folders. A note publishes only if BOTH axes say serve.
path_zone_notes._landing: One entry per note source (ADR-0017). `raw/import` is Apple Notes, `raw/notion` a Notion export, `raw/files` a directory of text; a plugin's adapter brings its own. They start HELD, and the matching is by longest declared prefix — so a source with no entry here inherits nothing and fails the build instead, which is the only safe answer to a question nobody was asked.

folder_notes.Journal: The clearest case of a folder that must never leave. Yours will differ.
folder_notes: The unfiled drawer (ADR-0009). A note with no folder is a note nobody decided about, and an undecided note is exactly the kind that should not leave. Held by default; change it deliberately.

sensitive_rows._doc: Row-level decisions inside an otherwise-served zone. Explicit, because the default for medical data should never be inherited from a zone.

chat_topics._doc: Conversation TITLES and volume only — t0_chat itself stays held. Titles are auto-generated from content, so a private conversation gets a revealing title; these two rules are the review, and both are deliberate rather than pattern-matched.
chat_topics._window_doc: Recency is the point: an assistant needs what the owner is working through now. Older topics carry the same exposure with far less value.
chat_topics._hold_doc: Named explicitly, not matched. A regex over titles would hold 'Therapy speak as emptiness' (criticism already published as a note) and miss anything private with a bland title — the same argument ADR-0009 made for notes.
